criteria.expectedBehavior: Expiry blocks access at the exact UTC expiry instant
Physical purge removes expired raw temporary PII within the deadline
TTL cannot be extended beyond the 30-day absolute maximum
Only one authorized renewal with reason is accepted
Cleanup worker is idempotent and retries after transient failure
Temporary data never appears in global people search or generic autocomplete
Promotion requires an explicit person choice and duplicate check; promotion is atomic and idempotent
Logs, audit, metrics and CI artifacts do not contain raw temporary PII
All code-discovered PartyId consumers are registered
Every PartyId reference has exactly one merge classification
Every participant implements versioned Prepare/Validate/Apply/Verify/Recovery contract
Merge preview is read-only and counts active, historical, transferable and blocking references
Merge is atomic, concurrency-safe and idempotent; failures leave no partial state
Historical snapshots stay unchanged and active references reconcile exactly
Every required gate job is present, always scheduled, and cannot be bypassed with path filters.
A gate with an implementation marker but missing/invalid evidence fails closed.
G1 cannot be authorized without real remote SCM, approval, and enforcement evidence.
CI evidence contains commit, contract versions, schema fingerprint, gate/test counts, and no raw PII.

note: AC-31..38 remain UNMAPPED pending full temporary-data lifecycle and PII evidence. AC-39..43 are mapped to explicit consumer registry/classification and Finance merge participant/preview/conflict tests. AC-44..45 remain UNMAPPED because complete combined concurrency/rollback/reconciliation and historical snapshot evidence is still incomplete. AC-46..49 are CI-policy/evidence tests only; they do not demonstrate the remaining runtime acceptance criteria.

runtimeCoverageCaveat.AC31toAC38: Partial temporary workflow ciphertext store/retention worker; exact expiry, purge, renewal, promotion, generic-search isolation and telemetry redaction criteria are not yet individually proven.
runtimeCoverageCaveat.AC39toAC40: Every external PartyId consumer is source-enumerated, registered exactly once and assigned one accepted merge classification; automated test plus the registry CI gate.
runtimeCoverageCaveat.AC41: The current Finance merge participant is checked against each versioned Preview/Prepare/Validate/Apply/Verify/Recover protocol hook. Future participants must be added to the registry and tested.
runtimeCoverageCaveat.AC42toAC43: Finance merge preview counts references without mutation and an unresolved dual-account conflict blocks execution.
runtimeCoverageCaveat.AC44toAC45: Focused atomicity, retry, rollback, concurrency and created-metadata tests exist, but complete acceptance for all references, historical snapshots and reconciliation remains open.
runtimeCoverageCaveat.AC46toAC49: CI policy/evidence controls only; not runtime acceptance.
